WITH RECURSIVE edges AS (
  SELECT caller_symbol_id AS src, callee_symbol_id AS dst
  FROM code.calls c
  JOIN code.symbols s1 ON s1.symbol_id = c.caller_symbol_id
  JOIN code.symbols s2 ON s2.symbol_id = c.callee_symbol_id
  WHERE s1.file_id = 'httpx/_client.py' AND s2.file_id = 'httpx/_client.py'
    AND c.call_kind <> 'callback'
), target AS (
  SELECT symbol_id FROM code.symbols
  WHERE file_id = 'httpx/_client.py' AND name = '_send_single_request'
), reach(symbol_id) AS (
  SELECT src FROM edges WHERE dst IN (SELECT symbol_id FROM target)
  UNION
  SELECT e.src FROM edges e JOIN reach r ON e.dst = r.symbol_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT r.symbol_id
FROM reach r
WHERE r.symbol_id NOT IN (SELECT symbol_id FROM target)
ORDER BY r.symbol_id
